columns_never_fillable.reason: Elite UK REIT holds 149 UK Government-leased commercial properties but discloses per-property valuation/NIA only for the TOP 10 by valuation (p34-37). The remaining ~139 properties are NOT itemised anywhere in the AR, and Note 27 Segment Information (p167) states no segment breakdown is presented (all assets are UK commercial). Only the top 10 property rows are captured; portfolio totals live in performance/financial. Not a parsing miss.
Occupancy disclosed only at portfolio level (93.9%, p26); not disclosed per property.

Per-property audited FY gross revenue is NOT disclosed. The top-10 property cards (p34-37) disclose only an 'Annualised Gross Rental Income' snapshot (a forward annualised GRI figure, different basis from the audited FY revenue, and for 10/149 assets only), so it cannot be reconciled to the audited group gross revenue GBP 39,076k and is intentionally NOT stored in properties.gross_revenue. The disclosed annualised-GRI figures are preserved in data_with_no_home.
Per-property NPI not disclosed; the AR gives only portfolio NPI (audited SCI, p139).

parsing_traps: December FY-end: financial_year=2024 = year ended 31 December 2024. Reporting currency is GBP (Pound sterling) throughout — NOT converted to SGD (FX happens downstream).

Headline 'Revenue GBP 37.5m' and 'NPI GBP 37.4m' (p5) EXCLUDE straight-line rent adjustments and are NOT the audited figures. The audited Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income (p139) shows Revenue 36,472 + Other property income 2,604 = gross revenue 39,076 (000), NPI 36,342 (000). Extraction uses the audited figures for total_revenue / gross_income so the reconciliation self-check ties.

Note 25 'Amount available for distribution' (p166): the for-year distributable income BEFORE retention (B) = 18,454 (000) = profit 20,495 + distribution adjustments (2,041); the cumulative 'Amount available' 24,953 folds in opening carry-forward 7,881 (A) and less retention 1,382. distribution_pool_other_movements = -1,382 (retention). Guard A + B + other - P = 7,881 + 18,454 - 1,382 - 16,017 = 8,936 = E (closing). Holds exactly.
Net finance costs in the P&L is 11,789 (finance income 1,338 less finance costs 13,127). Per §6 LOCKED, interest_expense_non_operating = GROSS finance costs = 13,127 (not netted).
net_property_sales = 321 (Gain on divestment of INVESTMENT PROPERTIES per p139) — an investment-property disposal gain, correctly included. No subsidiary/JV-stake disposal gains this year.
